title: Three Januaries and One Short Axe
subtitle: 山川山地 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 山川山地（人与自然·自然生态·山川与地形）
meta: 主题语境：山川山地（人与自然·自然生态·山川与地形）　|　核心词汇：ice　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the climber ① cut the ice that no villager in the mountain would have described, and he said the cutting was the whole of the January. The ② ice, meaning the frost itself and not the axe, ran three Januarys and stayed undescribed in the book; ice, he said, is the only thing in a mountain that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of ice in that mountain had the same short axe beside it, and the ④ ice at the far ledge, meaning the layer they kept for the children to chip and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Ice, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the climber said the describing is the part that fills three Januarys.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ice was the whole of the matter, meaning the silence and not the frost. The ⑥ ice, meaning the silence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; ice, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both frost and a silence. He said the silence is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ ice had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short axe. The ⑧ ice of the whole thing, the climber wrote in February, was one mountain and three Januarys of describing; ice, he said, is either the layer at the far ledge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ice I remember is the ice described in the record, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the mountain. ⑩ Ice, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being described; all ice, she said, is a silence that has agreed to look like frost. She said the silence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 冰；冰层（指山区里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 冰；冰层（指那层冰层本身，与冰镐相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the ice 凿冰
D. n. 冰；冰层（指留给孩子们敲的那一层那一层）
E. n. 冰事（抽象总称，指一处山区的冰之事）
F. n. 冰；冰层（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一层）
G. n. 冷峻、静默（指一件事里人人都踩却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 静默（抽象总称，指人人都踩却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the ice that no villager in the mountain would have described
The ice, meaning the frost itself and not the axe
Every kind of ice in that mountain
the ice at the far ledge
the ice was the whole of the matter
the ice had become a line in a record
The ice of the whole thing

answers.why: cut the ice 意为“凿冰”，1969 年那位登山者把山区里没有一位村民肯描述的一层冰做了一遍。
ice 意为“冰；冰层”，指那层冰层本身而不是冰镐，它经过了三个一月而在簿子上没有被描述。
ice 意为“冰；冰层”，指山区里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把小小的冰镐。
ice 意为“冰；冰层”，指最远那道岩台留给孩子们敲的那一层那一层，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ice 意为“冷峻、静默”，指一件事里人人都踩却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片静默就是那件事的全部。
ice 意为“静默”，指人人都踩却无人提起的那样东西而不是那层冰层，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ice 意为“冰；冰层”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一层，到 1974 年这一层成了记录里的一行。
ice 意为“冰事”，登山者二月写道，整件事的冰之事是一处山区和三个一月的描述。
ice 意为“冰；冰层”，我记得的是记录里描述过的那一层，1976 年消融了，至今仍被说成山区里最安静的一层。
ice 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，冰是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的冰层。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年那位登山者凿了山区里没有一位村民肯描述的一层冰，他说这一遍才是那个一月的全部。（cut the ice）
那层冰，指的是那层冰层本身而不是冰镐，经过了三个一月而在簿子上没有被描述。（ice）
那处山区里每一种冰旁边都有同一把小小的冰镐。（ice）
最远那道岩台那层冰，指的是他们留给孩子们敲的那一层那一层，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（ice）
叔叔说这片静默就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那层冰层。（ice）
1978 年母亲说，冰是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的冰层。（ice）

The ice at the far ledge, meaning the layer they kept for the children to chip and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
